runtime.cuda: NOT_RUN / outside this CPU acceptance profile

sampling.source: generated solely from frozen joint limits; no C1-02 shards
sampling.float32: round then move any out-of-limit endpoint one float32 ULP inward; persist exact resulting q32; reference uses q32 promoted to float64

fk.aggregate: every sample passes both; no averages gate

gradient.reference: central differences of Pinocchio FK output components/scalars; not Torch numerical forward
gradient.edge_stencil: at lower: (-3*f(q)+4*f(q+h)-f(q+2h))/(2h); at upper: (3*f(q)-4*f(q-h)+f(q-2h))/(2h); each column independently; h=1e-6; never clip; same atol/rtol; report separately
gradient.jacobian: dp/dq and vee(0.5*(dR/dq*R.T - R*(dR/dq).T)); compare all 6 columns with IndependentJacobian and PinocchioJacobian in base axes; same atol/rtol

sensitivity.direction: negative normalized gradient of frozen smooth loss

smoke.gate: analytic fixtures, both dtype FK, components backward, first two gradient cases; stop before full on any failure

evidence.raw_policy: small raw results committed; if large, explicit path/bytes/rows/SHA256 and LOCAL_ONLY until remote archive verified
evidence.clean_reproduction: second fresh checkout + fresh locked Pixi environment + isolated pinned Torch overlay; no copied environment; both complete gates required
